text: Kala anndirɗo jeyɗo wasiyee on ooñagol e goonga kan maa ɗawre ka wasiyee,o moƴƴiŋtiniri bonannd e wasiyiiɗo on annasiya,o moƴƴiŋtini hakkunde pooɗondirɓe ɓen ka wasiyee,bakkaatu fawaaki mo.Toode o yoɓete e ngol moƴƴiŋtingol.Pellet Alla ko Yawtanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Yurmotooɗo ɓe.
